texto: **别 + verbo** serves to give a negative instruction: **别忘了吃药** («Don't forget to take the medicine.»). **一天吃三次药** indicates a frequency: «take medicine three times a day».
To locate the pharmacy, use **药店在医院左边/右边** («The pharmacy is on the left / right of the hospital»).
